text: mohakkhayo idaṃ brahmacariyapariyosānanti . [31] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi . ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayoti bhante vuccati . kissa nu kho etaṃ bhante adhivacanaṃ rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayoti . nibbānadhātuyā kho etaṃ bhikkhu adhivacanaṃ rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayoti . āsavānaṃ khayo tena vuccatīti . [32] evaṃ vutte so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca amataṃ amatanti bhante vuccati . katamaṃ nu kho bhante amataṃ katamo amatagāmimaggoti . yo kho bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo
